title: MCX gold rallies for fifth straight week; gains  ₹19,000 per 10 grams in August
summary: MCX gold prices in India rose for the fifth week, gaining nearly  ₹8,000 per 10 grams to settle at  ₹1,62,438. Gold's August gains reached 13%, supported by a declining U.S. dollar and reduced expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike.

title: Korean Traders Chase 40% Coupons as Risk Appetite Survives Rout
summary: A historic stock selloff has driven South Korea’s retail investors toward complex structured products as the risk-loving cohort continues to look for ways to boost returns.

title: Paramount and California to hold preliminary talks on Monday over Warner Bros deal: Report
summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta and 11 other state attorneys general filed a lawsuit in July seeking to block the proposed $110 billion acquisition.
